renderer: flyvis.datasets.rendering.BoxEye(extent=15, kernel_size=13) applied via flyvis.datasets.rendering.utils.split(out_nelements=min_frame_size[1]+2*kernel_size, n_splits=1, center_crop_fraction=0.7) then boxfilter(..., ftype='mean') -- the same pipeline flyvis.datasets.sintel.RenderedSintel uses to build MultiTaskSintel's lum channel (vertical_splits fixed to 1 here: a single rendering of the whole cropped frame, not flyvis's default 3-way left/mid/right split). Grayscale via PIL.Image.open(...).convert('L') (flyvis.datasets.sintel_utils.sample_lum), matching flyvis exactly.
uv_ordering: uv[i] = (u, v) axial hex coordinates of hexal i, in exactly the order BoxEye._receptor_centers() yields them: for u in range(-extent, extent+1): for v in range(max(-extent, -extent-u), min(extent, extent-u)+1): yield (u, v). This is the same order as every array BoxEye/RenderedSintel/MultiTaskSintel returns along its hexal axis (constraint: max(|u|,|v|,|u+v|) <= extent).
